title: Son and Daughter, Two Different Roots
label: ch:te-son-and-daughter
canDo: I can say son and daughter in Telugu, and show that they trace to two different Proto-Dravidian roots rather than one shared root.

payoff.summary: Line up కొడుకు and కూతురు against their two separate Proto-Dravidian roots, trace కొడుకు's own root sideways to కోడలు ("daughter-in-law"), and trace కూతురు's root across the family to Kannada's word for infant.
